channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta segunda (14/9)
item.description: On Monday (September 14), seven candidates for São Paulo governor continue their electoral agendas on the 30th day of the 2026 campaign. Tarcísio de Freitas and Fernando Haddad lead the polls, but only Haddad announced scheduled events. Candidates like Carlos Machado, Policial Edjane, Vera Lúcia, and Vivian Mendes have not disclosed their plans, while Izadora Dias will hold meetings and produce digital content. The campaign proceeds at varying paces among contenders.

item.title: Celular de Vorcaro vira disputa no STF às vésperas de sessão sobre Moraes
item.description: A dispute has emerged at the STF regarding access to the full content extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, with ministers Zanin and Gilmar Mendes requesting the data from the PF, while Minister André Mendonça opposes its release before the trial. Tensions escalate ahead of the session analyzing Petition 16.662, linked to alleged messages between Alexandre de Moraes and Vorcaro.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos candidatos ao ao GDF nesta segunda-feira (14/9)
item.description: Candidates for the GDF hold campaign events across various regions of Brasília on Monday, with emphasis on interviews and voter interactions. Celina Leão (PP), the leading candidate in polls, suspends her schedule to care for her hospitalized mother.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro travam batalha jurídica contra acusações sem provas
item.description: TSE suspends electoral ads with unsubstantiated accusations against Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, classifying as misinformation facts without context or charges without evidence. Lawyers for the candidates are legally disputing to block contents considered fake news.

item.title: Traições à esquerda e à direita em eleição ao Senado no Rio põem sob risco aliados de Lula e de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Senate race in Rio reveals internal betrayals in both alliances: PT and Bolsonarists face resistance from their bases to consolidate votes, with divergent endorsements for left and right-wing candidates, threatening the alliance strategies of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Segurança reforçada, telão no STF e transmissão pela TV: saiba como será a sessão que pode abrir investigação contra Moraes
item.description: The STF will hold an extraordinary session with heightened security to debate potential investigation against Minister Moraes, following revelations of messages between Vorcaro and authorities during the Banco Master crisis.

item.title: Novo embate de ala de Moraes contra Mendonça por dados do celular de Vorcaro escala tensão pré-julgamento
item.description: STF ministers clash over the analysis of Daniel Vorcaro's phone, with Zanin and Gilmar ordering data delivery while Mendonça opposes it. The conflict escalates pre-trial tension and may influence debates on procedural issues in Tuesday's session. The dispute among judges reflects divergent views on transparency and secrecy in sensitive investigations.

item.title: Manifestação sobre celular de Vorcaro será mais um teste para Fachin, que tenta evitar 'tumulto' em julgamento de Moraes
item.description: The Supreme Court trial of Alexandre de Moraes faces new tensions over access to Daniel Vorcaro's phone data. Justices disagree on sharing or restricting the data, while Fachin seeks to prevent 'procedural tumult' and keeps Tuesday's hearing scheduled.

item.title: O que faz uma celebridade ser realmente influente? Grazi Massafera ajuda a entender
item.description: Grazi Massafera was elected the most influential personality in Brazil in the 2026 MIC² survey, scoring 137 points with emphasis on beauty, style, and authenticity. Conducted by Ipsos with 2,000 respondents, the research reveals that influence goes beyond follower count, valuing traits such as trust, inspiration, and political engagement. Experts emphasize that influencing means generating identification and behavioral change, not just popularity.

item.title: Com menos candidatos, SP tem eleição ao governo mais diversa do século
item.description: The 2026 election for São Paulo state government marks the highest racial and gender diversity of the century, with 42.9% of candidates being Black or Brown, including three Black or Brown women for the first time. Despite having the fewest candidates (seven), the race stands out for its representativeness, contrasting with previous elections dominated by whites and men.

item.title: No Z4 do Brasileirão, Remo leva vantagem no histórico recente contra Bahia
item.description: In the 27th round of the Brazilian Championship, Bahia and Remo face each other at Arena Fonte Nova. Remo leads the recent head-to-head with four wins against one from Bahia. However, Bahia is in 5th place with 43 points, while Remo sits in 19th, fighting relegation.

item.title: Yasmin Brunet é a modelo mais aguardada da estreia do Metrópoles Catwalk
item.description: The 2026 Metrópoles Catwalk highlighted Yasmin Brunet, who walked for the Brasília-based brands Biruta and Zinc Complements. Known for her fashion career and appearance on BBB24, the model is among the most anticipated personalities at the event.

item.title: As veias abertas do STF e os embates sobre o fim do sigilo no Caso Master - O Assunto #1803
item.description: The STF faces one of its most tense moments with disputes over the secrecy of the Master Case, involving investigations against lawmakers and politicians' relatives. The crisis reflects institutional tensions and suspicions about ministers' impartiality.

item.title: Los nietos del exilio y el derecho a votar suspendido
item.description: On September 10, 2026, the Spanish Supreme Court ordered the provisional suspension of registration in CERA for descendants of exiles who acquired Spanish nationality under the 2022 Democracy Memory Law, consequently suspending their right to vote. The measure requires impartial analysis, free from political polarization.

item.title: ¿'Lawfare’ o pucherazo?
item.description: The article discusses political polarization in Brazil, linking it to issues such as the grandchildren's law and restrictions on voting rights of naturalized citizens, criticizing the loss of maturity in public debates. It questions whether the situation constitutes lawfare or electoral manipulation (pucherazo).

item.title: Organograma cita “Mário” como sócio de produtora de “Dark Horse” nos EUA
item.description: A document seized by the São Paulo Civil Police during the Wi-Fi Livre SP operation indicates a person named Mário as a partner of the U.S.-based production company Go Up Entertainment, responsible for the film 'Dark Horse' about former president Jair Bolsonaro. The document, linked to Karina Ferreira da Gama—who leads the Instituto Conhecer Brasil and is a partner of Go Up in Brazil—raises suspicions of irregular political funding, particularly involving parliamentary amendments and resources from businessman Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Eleição vai para a prorrogação
item.description: Quaest poll shows Lula leading the first round with 36% against 29% for Flávio, tying at 41% each in the second round. Both face high rejection rates (53% for Lula and 55% for Flávio). The race remains open with no definitive outcome yet.

item.title: VÍDEO: Como consultar o horário e local de votação?
item.description: The content explains how to find voting time and location for the 2026 elections using tools such as the TSE self-service and the e-title app. The G1 series of 50 videos covers topics like how voting works, contested positions and the impact of technologies on campaigns. Voting takes place from 8am to 5pm Brasília time, with adjustments according to the local timezone of each region.

item.title: Impeachment de juízes de supremas cortes é raridade em democracias pelo mundo
item.description: Suspicion surrounding Alexandre de Moraes in the Banco Master case renews debates about impeachment at the STF. Across democracies, removing supreme court judges is rare and institutionally sensitive.

item.title: Precisamos ressuscitar o STF, diz o ex-ministro da Justiça José Carlos Dias
item.description: Former Minister of Justice José Carlos Dias, 87, says the STF needs to be revived to strengthen democracy and human rights. Though retired after over 60 years of practice, he remains engaged in the causes he has long defended.

item.title: Sessão sobre crise no STF tem rito incerto, artilharia montada entre Moraes e Mendonça e risco de obstrução
item.description: The STF faces an unprecedented crisis in the Master case, with uncertain proceedings and risk of obstruction, as ministers Moraes and Mendonça lead rival factions in an intense dispute.

item.title: Caetano Veloso declara novamente apoio a Lula para presidente
item.description: Caetano Veloso reiterated his support for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during a show in the Federal District, making the 'L' gesture and saying 'go, Lula'. First Lady Janja Lula and other artists, including Chico Buarque and Maria Bethânia, also expressed support for the PT candidate in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Roberta Luchsinger pede que produtora de “Dark Horse” não seja julgada
item.description: Roberta Luchsinger asked that producer Karina Gama, investigated in the 'Dark Horse' funding case, not be prematurely judged by public opinion. The businesswoman emphasized defense of rights and guarantees, without taking a stance on the producer's responsibility. The investigations involve irregular INSS discounts and use of parliamentary amendments.

item.title: Caiado diz que indicará Hajjar para pasta da Saúde e Dodge para o STF
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) announced potential cabinet picks for a future government, including doctor Ludhmila Hajjar for the Ministry of Health and former prosecutor Raquel Dodge for the Supreme Court. He emphasized their independence and clean record, describing them as symbols of courage and competence for Brazil.

item.title: Criminalistas veem pedido de Zanin à PF como atípico e dizem que medida contorna Mendonça e Fachin
item.description: Minister Cristiano Zanin directly requested data from Daniel Vorcaro's phone from the Federal Police, bypassing standard procedures under André Mendonça's rapporteurship. This move highlights internal tensions within the STF, as other justices also seek access to the material. Criminal lawyers deem access justified but question the procedure used.

item.title: Lulinha pagará “preço muito alto” se tiver culpa, diz Lula
item.description: In a live about his reelection campaign, Lula said his son will 'pay a very high price' if involved in an illegal discount scheme at INSS, while criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro over his company sharing an address with 16 firms linked to 'Careca do INSS'. The PT leader reiterated claims of a 'gang' operating in Social Security under Bolsonaro's government, referencing the Banco Master case and Daniel Vorcaro, amid a tight electoral race for 2026.

item.title: Dark Horse: gestão Nunes paga R$ 4 milhões por mês em contrato de wi-fi
item.description: The Nunes administration pays R$4 million monthly to an NGO linked to the Dark Horse film producer under investigation for alleged corruption and misuse of funds. The mayor claims he will seek STF authorization to terminate the contract, while the city hall denies any wrongdoing.

item.title: Veja imagens de atos do PT em ao menos 6 Estados neste domingo
item.description: The PT held rallies in at least six states supporting Lula's reelection, including São Paulo, Brasília, Bahia, Rio de Janeiro, Piauí, and Amazonas. First Lady Janja and figures like Haddad, Alckmin, and Edinho Silva took part in the events, reinforcing backing for the candidate. Activities featured walks, parades, and flag-bearing gatherings.

item.title: Perícia aponta falha em lacre de 27 dispositivos apreendidos em operação contra produtora de 'Dark Horse'
item.description: A forensic audit by the São Paulo Civil Police identified flaws in 27 electronic devices seized during an operation targeting the producer of the film 'Dark Horse', linked to the Instituto Conhecer Brasil. The devices, allegedly tied to a R$108 million contract with the city for wi-fi installation, had poorly sealed enclosures allowing unauthorized access. The investigation aims to confirm whether funds from the contract were diverted to finance the production of the film about Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Anotações apreendidas com empresária indicam ‘Mario’ como sócio da produtora de Dark Horse
item.description: The São Paulo Civil Police seized notes linking federal deputy Mário Frias to the funding of the film Dark Horse, a biography of Jair Bolsonaro. Investigators claim that R$2 million from an amendment by the lawmaker was channeled to the production company Go UP Entertainment, owned by entrepreneur Karina Gama. The case is under review at the Supreme Federal Court on suspicion of public fund misuse.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes pede íntegra de celular de Vorcaro à PF
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes requested the Federal Police to provide the full content extracted from Daniel Vorcaro's phone, used to support the petition 16.662 that will be judged by the STF. The case involves investigations into possible irregularities in the relationship between Minister Alexandre de Moraes and the founder of Banco Master, Daniel Vorcaro, generating an institutional crisis at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Lula cita inflação menor que Bolsonaro, mas diz que comida “está cara”
item.description: Lula emphasized that food inflation was lower during his administration (13.6%) compared to Bolsonaro's (56.17%), while acknowledging that food prices remain high. He also criticized Flávio Bolsonaro for allegedly having a secret fiscal adjustment plan and advocated for raising the minimum wage.

item.title: Sem citar nomes, Lula diz haver candidato “capataz” e no meio da milícia
item.description: Lula criticizes unnamed opponents, calling one a 'slave farm overseer' and another tied to militias, targeting the PL. He advocates for public security reforms and mentions natural resource exploitation alongside investigations involving relatives.

item.title: “Fanático e negacionista não quer argumento, quer confusão”, diz Lula
item.description: Lula urged supporters to counter misinformation with government achievements, emphasizing education, health, and science. He labeled opponents as 'fanatics' and 'deniers' who seek confusion, not dialogue. The PT candidate called for increased activism on social media and on the streets ahead of the October 4 vote.

item.title: Milhares vão às ruas a favor da reeleição de Lula
item.description: Thousands of Lula's supporters took to the streets in several cities to defend his re-election. The demonstrations also protested against the Banco Master scandal involving Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: É importante saber o que diz a Constituição sobre segurança pública, diz Lula em transmissão
item.description: Lula stated in a live broadcast that it is important to know what the Federal Constitution says about public security. The president, running for reelection, highlighted the topic as a priority in his speech.

item.title: Quero que a gente conquiste definitivamente o fim da escala 6x1, diz Lula à militância
item.description: Presidente Lula told party supporters in a Sunday live stream that he wants Brazil to definitively end the 6x1 work shift scale, as part of his reelection campaign push.

item.title: Em live para a militância, Lula chama Flávio de miliciano
item.description: In a livestream aimed at party activists, Lula called Flávio Bolsonaro a militia member and sharpened his rhetoric against his main rival.

item.title: Lula: criaram banqueiro e criaram quadrilha da previdência social; nós prendemos os envolvidos
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, seeking re-election, claimed his administration 'created a banker' and dismantled a 'social security gang' from the previous government, while his administration imprisoned those involved. The statement, made on May 13, reinforces his anti-corruption and economic management narrative.

item.title: Lula faz 'live' com apoiadores no Alvorada; em 2022, TSE proibiu Bolsonaro de promover própria campanha no palácio
item.description: Lula held a live with supporters at the Alvorada Palace to promote his reelection bid, using campaign equipment, despite the TSE having prohibited Bolsonaro from doing the same at the palace in 2022. His campaign claims full compliance with TSE regulations, while the president directly criticized opponent Flávio Bolsonaro during the broadcast.

item.title: Arruda promete construir hospital e levar VLT até São Sebastião
item.description: José Roberto Arruda (PSD) campaigned through São Sebastião, promising to build a hospital and bring the VLT to the region via the fourth bridge. He also emphasized saving the Banco de Brasília (BRB) to boost the local economy and defended the legality of his candidacy, urging the popular vote to decide the election.

item.title: Crítica: Lola Young mostra personalidade em seu som sincerão no Palco Mundo
item.description: Lola Young delivered an authentic and charismatic performance at Rock in Rio 2026's Palco Mundo stage, braving rain and sound issues with humor. The 25-year-old British singer, open about her struggles with addiction, won over the Brazilian audience with a diverse setlist spanning pop, blues, and soul, ending the show emotionally.

item.title: Moraes diz a Fachin que Mendonça mantém sob sigilo ‘elementos essenciais’ para julgamento
item.description: Justice Minister Alexandre de Moraes asked STF President Edson Fachin to lift the seal on an investigation related to the Master Bank frauds before Tuesday's trial. Fachin took over the rapporteurship of the probe into alleged ties between Moraes and former banker Daniel Vorcaro, replacing André Mendonça, amid a crisis at the STF.

item.title: Justiça manda retirar vídeo de Renan Filho sobre JHC e Banco Master
item.description: The TRE-AL ordered the removal of a Renan Filho video accusing JHC of being investigated in the IPREV/Banco Master case due to lack of evidence. The rapporteur cited an MPF certificate showing 'NADA CONSTA' and TSE precedent on political criticism limits. The race remains tied in polls for Alagoas governor.

item.title: A três semanas do 1º turno, Lula cobra engajamento de apoiadores nas redes
item.description: With 21 days to the first round, Lula urged supporters to engage online and on the streets, framing the election as truth versus lies. He attacked ex-presidents Collor and Bolsonaro, acknowledged campaign distribution errors and said the PT will recentralize material production.

item.title: Nas redes, direita enxerga blindagem de Fachin a Moraes, e esquerda proteção de Mendonça a Flávio
item.description: Social media showed a polarized split over the STF crisis: the right accused Fachin of shielding Moraes and PF, while the left alleged Mendonça protected Flávio Bolsonaro in the Dark Horse case. The PF leadership dispute and Dino's reversal dominated debates, with right-wing accounts producing 54% of posts, left 29% and press 17%.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha sai em defesa de produtora de filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger, friend of Lulinha, publicly defended film producer Karina Ferreira da Gama, behind the Dark Horse movie about Bolsonaro, amid two Federal Police investigations. Roberta is probed for alleged favors to the Lula administration through her ties to Lulinha, while Karina faces suspicion of misusing public funds and the film's budget through front NGOs.

item.title: Ex-ministros e economistas divulgam carta em apoio a Fachin
item.description: Former ministers and economists, including Pedro Malan, Armínio Fraga, and Miguel Reale Jr., issued an open letter supporting STF President Edson Fachin amid an institutional crisis at the Court. The signatories call for full transparency in the investigation involving Alexandre de Moraes and Daniel Vorcaro, and demand structural reforms to strengthen collegiality and impartiality within the STF.

item.title: QG de Flávio Bolsonaro vê ‘febre alta’ na economia antes do que Lula esperava
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro has leveraged the economic crisis to frame his campaign, emphasizing rising prices, household debt, and violence. Lula, conversely, has sought to align business leaders and outline fiscal policies, concerned about market response amid worsening economic conditions.

item.title: Pesquisas eleitorais mostram os números de Augusto Cury na última semana
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) remained in third place in all four presidential polls last week, but lost ground, dropping from 11% to 9% in BTG/Nexus and from 8% to 6% in Datafolha. In hypothetical second-round matchups, both BTG/Nexus and Datafolha show a technical tie between Cury and Lula at 45% to 43%.
